evidence_against.relevance: Casey regularly initiated contact and arranged approximately weekly one-on-one time over twelve weeks.
Casey invested time in Drew's important interview preparation and attended an important birthday dinner.
Casey independently resumed regular contact after two periods apart.

evidence_supporting.relevance: Casey twice declined to define the relationship and offered no timeline for revisiting it, supporting low commitment.
Meetings were usually convenient for Casey or arranged at short notice, and Casey canceled advance plans for other commitments.
Casey has not integrated Drew into close social or family circles and declined to make a plan two months ahead.

recommended_action.explanation: Drew could state the desired level of commitment and ask whether Casey is willing to revisit definition and future planning within a specific timeframe.

uncertainty_explanation: Casey's sustained initiation, practical support, and resumed contact show meaningful interest, but repeated avoidance of definition, limited advance planning, convenience-oriented meetings, cancellations, and lack of social integration more strongly support low-commitment involvement.
